title: The interplay between partial specification, average shadowing, and Besicovitch completeness
summary: Let $(X,T)$ be a compact dynamical system. This article proves that if $(X,T)$ has the partial specification property, then it has the average shadowing property. It is also proven that if $(X,T)$ is surjective and has the partial specification property, then the set of ergodic measures of $(X,T)$ is dense in the space of its invariant measures. An example of a compact dynamical system that is not Besicovitch complete is also given.
